description: Config-driven browser flow descriptor for China Unicom Cloud Drive desktop web login, personal-space upload, directory creation, deletion, rename, copy, and move.
notes: This file records selectors, JS entrypoints, and expected network requests without storing live credentials.
Placeholders such as {{inputs.sms_code}} and {{runtime.access_token}} are symbolic and must be resolved at runtime by the browser automation layer.
When pan.wo.cn changes its DOM, update this file first before changing Rust provider logic.

pages.title: Unicom Web Login
notes: The successful login flow observed on 2026-05-11 used the SMS login tab rather than password login.

pages.title: Unicom Personal File List
notes: The page exposes the uploader file input under #global-uploader-btn after the Vue action entrypoint initializes upload params.

pages.title: Unicom Delete Action Dialog
notes: The delete confirmation is driven by the action-dialog child component under the file list container.

pages.title: Unicom Copy Or Move Action Dialog
notes: The copy and move flows reuse the action-dialog child component after the parent file-list component populates dialogType and dialogData from the current selection.
The DOM text matcher is more stable than the generated class list for this tab.
The button text is intentionally broad because some builds show '登录/注册' or similar variants.
The input exists only after the global uploader widget is mounted.
The current implementation prefers the list component method createDir() over direct DOM dialog automation, but this selector is still recorded as a fallback anchor.
Observed during successful SMS login on 2026-05-11.
Do not persist live phone number, SMS code, or returned token in this file.
This request is auxiliary and was seen after login and after upload, but it is not the upload commit primitive.
The successful personal-root upload observed on 2026-05-11 returned fid, fileVersion, and wcFileId directly from upload2C.
fileInfo is not plain JSON on the wire; the runtime must apply the same encryption logic as the web client or delegate to the page uploader component.
Observed end-to-end on 2026-05-11 by calling the file-list component createDir() method with a temporary probe directory.
The decrypted request body shape recovered from the page method is: isCouldRepeat=1, spaceType, parentDirectoryId, directoryName, plus familyId or psToken when required by the current space.
Observed end-to-end on 2026-05-11 by wiring the action-dialog deleteFile() method to a temporary probe directory.
The recovered request payload before encryption is: spaceType, vipLevel, dirList, fileList.
Observed end-to-end on 2026-05-12 by calling renameFileOrDirectory() against a temporary probe file in personal root.
The recovered request payload before encryption is: spaceType, type, fileType, id, name, plus familyId or psToken when required by the current space.
Observed end-to-end on 2026-05-12 by selecting a temporary probe directory, opening the copy action-dialog, setting currentDir, and submitting through onSubmit().
The recovered request payload before encryption is: targetDirId, sourceType, targetType, dirList, fileList, plus optional familyId.
Observed end-to-end on 2026-05-12 by selecting a temporary probe directory, opening the move action-dialog, allowing QueryDirectorys to settle, and then submitting through onSubmit().
The recovered request payload before encryption is: targetDirId, sourceType, targetType, dirList, fileList, plus optional familyId and fromFamilyId when the source space is family.

operations.source: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('.actions'); const vm = root && (root.__vue__ || root.__vueParentComponent?.proxy); if (!vm || typeof vm.goUpload !== 'function') { throw new Error('actions.goUpload not available'); } vm.goUpload(false); return { directoryId: vm.directoryId ?? null, spaceType: vm.spaceType ?? null, currentPath: location.href }; })()
notes: This is the crucial page-level entrypoint that prepares uploader params before the file input receives a file.
Directly pushing a file into the input without calling goUpload(false) was observed to fail because params.fileInfo was missing.

operations.source: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('.uploader-container'); const vm = root && (root.__vue__ || root.__vueParentComponent?.proxy); if (!vm) { return null; } return { target: vm.options?.target ?? null, params: vm.params ?? null }; })()
notes: Useful as a diagnostic hook after page revisions to confirm that fileInfo and upload target are still populated.

operations.source: (() => { const vm = document.querySelector('.file-list-container')?.__vue__ || document.querySelector('.file-list-container')?.__vueParentComponent?.proxy; if (!vm || typeof vm.createDir !== 'function') { throw new Error('file-list createDir not available'); } vm.dirName = '{{inputs.directory_name}}'; return vm.createDir().then(() => ({ cloudType: vm.cloudType, parentDirectoryId: vm.lastRoute?.id ?? '0', requestedDirectoryName: vm.dirName })); })()
notes: The recovered method body constructs { spaceType: cloudType, parentDirectoryId: lastRoute.id, directoryName: dirName } and conditionally adds familyId or psToken.

operations.source: (() => { const listVm = document.querySelector('.file-list-container')?.__vue__ || document.querySelector('.file-list-container')?.__vueParentComponent?.proxy; if (!listVm) { throw new Error('file-list component not available'); } const dialogVm = (listVm.$children || []).find(child => child.$options?.name === 'action-dialog'); if (!dialogVm || typeof dialogVm.deleteFile !== 'function') { throw new Error('action-dialog deleteFile not available'); } const entryName = '{{inputs.entry_name}}'; const entry = (listVm.tableData || []).find(item => (item.name || item.directoryName || item.fileName) === entryName); if (!entry) { throw new Error('entry not found for deletion: ' + entryName); } dialogVm.data = { cloudType: listVm.cloudType, dirIds: entry.type === 0 ? [entry.id] : [], fileIds: entry.type === 0 ? [] : [entry.id] }; return dialogVm.deleteFile().then(() => ({ deletedEntryId: entry.id, deletedEntryType: entry.type, cloudType: listVm.cloudType })); })()
notes: The recovered action-dialog deleteFile() method posts { spaceType: data.cloudType, vipLevel, dirList, fileList } through the DeleteFile dispatcher operation.

operations.source: (() => { const listVm = document.querySelector('.file-list-container')?.__vue__ || document.querySelector('.file-list-container')?.__vueParentComponent?.proxy; if (!listVm || typeof listVm.renameFileOrDirectory !== 'function') { throw new Error('file-list renameFileOrDirectory not available'); } const entryName = '{{inputs.entry_name}}'; const renamedBase = '{{inputs.new_name}}'; const entry = (listVm.tableData || []).find(item => (item.name || item.directoryName || item.fileName) === entryName); if (!entry) { throw new Error('entry not found for rename: ' + entryName); } return Promise.resolve(listVm.renameFileOrDirectory(entry, renamedBase)).then(() => ({ renamedEntryId: entry.id, renamedEntryType: entry.type, requestedName: renamedBase, fileType: entry.fileType || null, cloudType: listVm.cloudType })); })()
notes: Validated on 2026-05-12 against a temporary probe file in personal root.
For files, the page method receives a base name and preserves the original extension in the visible file list.

operations.source: new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const listVm = document.querySelector('.file-list-container')?.__vue__ || document.querySelector('.file-list-container')?.__vueParentComponent?.proxy; if (!listVm || typeof listVm.handleSelectionChange !== 'function' || typeof listVm.handleCopy !== 'function') { return reject(new Error('file-list copy hooks not available')); } const dialogVm = (listVm.$children || []).find(child => child.$options?.name === 'action-dialog'); if (!dialogVm || typeof dialogVm.onSubmit !== 'function') { return reject(new Error('action-dialog onSubmit not available')); } const entryName = '{{inputs.entry_name}}'; const targetDirName = '{{inputs.target_directory_name}}'; const entry = (listVm.tableData || []).find(item => (item.name || item.directoryName || item.fileName) === entryName); const target = (listVm.tableData || []).find(item => item.type === 0 && (item.name || item.directoryName || item.fileName) === targetDirName); if (!entry) { return reject(new Error('entry not found for copy: ' + entryName)); } if (!target) { return reject(new Error('target directory not found for copy: ' + targetDirName)); } listVm.handleSelectionChange([entry]); listVm.handleCopy(); listVm.$nextTick(() => { dialogVm.currentDir = { id: target.id, currentId: target.id, directoryName: target.name || target.directoryName || target.fileName, spaceType: target.spaceType || listVm.cloudType, familyId: target.familyId || sessionStorage.getItem('familyId') || '' }; Promise.resolve(dialogVm.onSubmit()).then(() => resolve({ copiedEntryId: entry.id, copiedEntryType: entry.type, targetDirId: target.id, targetDirName: target.name || target.directoryName || target.fileName, cloudType: listVm.cloudType })).catch(reject); }); })
notes: Validated on 2026-05-12 against temporary probe directories in personal root.
The parent component must derive dialogData from multipleSelection via handleSelectionChange() before handleCopy() so dirIds/fileIds stay aligned with the visible selection.

operations.source: new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const listVm = document.querySelector('.file-list-container')?.__vue__ || document.querySelector('.file-list-container')?.__vueParentComponent?.proxy; if (!listVm || typeof listVm.handleSelectionChange !== 'function' || typeof listVm.handleMove !== 'function') { return reject(new Error('file-list move hooks not available')); } const dialogVm = (listVm.$children || []).find(child => child.$options?.name === 'action-dialog'); if (!dialogVm || typeof dialogVm.onSubmit !== 'function') { return reject(new Error('action-dialog onSubmit not available')); } const entryName = '{{inputs.entry_name}}'; const targetDirName = '{{inputs.target_directory_name}}'; const entry = (listVm.tableData || []).find(item => (item.name || item.directoryName || item.fileName) === entryName); const target = (listVm.tableData || []).find(item => item.type === 0 && (item.name || item.directoryName || item.fileName) === targetDirName); if (!entry) { return reject(new Error('entry not found for move: ' + entryName)); } if (!target) { return reject(new Error('target directory not found for move: ' + targetDirName)); } listVm.handleSelectionChange([entry]); listVm.handleMove(); listVm.$nextTick(() => { setTimeout(() => { dialogVm.type = 'move'; dialogVm.data = { familyId: listVm.dialogData?.familyId, spaceType: listVm.dialogData?.spaceType, fileIds: listVm.dialogData?.fileIds || [], dirIds: listVm.dialogData?.dirIds || [] }; dialogVm.currentDir = { id: target.id, currentId: target.id, directoryName: target.name || target.directoryName || target.fileName, spaceType: target.spaceType || listVm.cloudType, familyId: target.familyId || '' }; Promise.resolve(dialogVm.onSubmit()).then(() => resolve({ movedEntryId: entry.id, movedEntryType: entry.type, targetDirId: target.id, targetDirName: target.name || target.directoryName || target.fileName, cloudType: listVm.cloudType })).catch(reject); }, 1500); }); })
notes: Validated on 2026-05-12 against temporary probe directories in personal root.
The extra delay mirrors the live page behavior where QueryDirectorys runs before the move dialog is ready to submit.

flows.title: Unicom SMS Login
flows.purpose: Drive the desktop web login page through SMS verification without hardcoding DOM logic in Rust.

inputs.label: Phone Number
inputs.description: Mainland China mobile number used for the interactive login.

inputs.label: SMS Code
inputs.description: Short-lived verification code typed by the operator after the page sends the SMS.

outputs.description: Access token captured from the post-login Vuex user store for follow-up dispatcher requests.
Family space identifier exposed in sessionStorage after a successful login.
Client identifier from the post-login Vuex user store.
Resolved URL after the login flow reaches the file list page.

notes: The flow intentionally keeps the SMS code as a runtime input; it should come from the operator or a control-plane verification queue.
If the login page text or tab component changes, selectors in the login.* elements should be updated before touching the execution engine.

flows.title: Unicom Prepare Personal Root Upload
flows.purpose: Open the page uploader and capture the personal-root upload context that the web client initializes before any file is attached.

outputs.source: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('.uploader-container'); const vm = root && (root.__vue__ || root.__vueParentComponent?.proxy); return vm?.params?.fileInfo?.batchNo ?? null; })()
outputs.description: Batch identifier generated by the uploader after personal-root upload preparation.

outputs.source: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('.uploader-container'); const vm = root && (root.__vue__ || root.__vueParentComponent?.proxy); return vm?.params?.fileInfo?.directoryId ?? null; })()
outputs.description: Prepared target directory id for the personal-root uploader context.

outputs.source: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('.uploader-container'); const vm = root && (root.__vue__ || root.__vueParentComponent?.proxy); return vm?.params?.fileInfo?.spaceType ?? null; })()
outputs.description: Prepared space type for the personal-root uploader context.

notes: Validated on 2026-05-12 against the logged-in personal root page by calling goUpload(false) without attaching a file.
This preparatory flow exists so later upload flows can reuse the initialized uploader context through auth-session runtime values.

flows.title: Unicom Personal Root Upload
flows.purpose: Attach a local file to the already-prepared personal-root uploader and watch the real upload2C request rather than synthesizing an incomplete multipart form in Rust.

inputs.label: Local File
inputs.description: Absolute path of the file that should be attached to the hidden uploader input.

outputs.description: Primary file identifier returned by a successful upload2C response.
Secondary storage file identifier returned by upload2C.

notes: Run unicom_prepare_personal_root_upload first on the same auth_session_id so batch_no, directory_id, and personal_space_type are captured from the live page uploader state.
This flow is intentionally scoped to personal root upload; family/private variants should be modelled as separate flows once their uploader contexts are captured end-to-end.
If upload2C form fields or the global uploader component change, update the request descriptor and JS operations here before rewriting provider code.

flows.title: Unicom Create Directory
flows.purpose: Create a directory in the current visible file list context by reusing the file-list Vue component rather than reconstructing an encrypted dispatcher payload manually.

inputs.label: Directory Name
inputs.description: Name of the directory to create in the current route context.

notes: Validated on 2026-05-11 with a temporary probe directory in personal root.
This flow currently records the component-driven path because it is more stable than guessing the new-directory dialog DOM.

flows.title: Unicom Delete Entry
flows.purpose: Delete a visible file or directory by driving the action-dialog component with the selected row payload.

inputs.label: Entry Name
inputs.description: Visible file or directory name in the current list context.

notes: Validated on 2026-05-11 against a temporary probe directory created and deleted in personal root.
The component method can target both directories and files by splitting ids into dirIds and fileIds.

flows.title: Unicom Rename Entry
flows.purpose: Rename a visible file or directory by reusing the file-list Vue component method that already knows how to encrypt the dispatcher payload.

inputs.label: Entry Name
inputs.description: Visible file or directory name in the current list context.

inputs.label: New Name
inputs.description: Requested new base name. For files, the page keeps the original extension.

notes: Validated on 2026-05-12 with a temporary probe file in personal root.
The current page implementation does not always issue an immediate QueryAllFiles refresh after rename, so the flow only waits for the dispatcher write.

flows.title: Unicom Copy Entry
flows.purpose: Copy a visible file or directory into another visible directory by driving the file-list selection state and action-dialog submit path.

inputs.label: Entry Name
inputs.description: Visible file or directory name in the current list context.

inputs.label: Target Directory Name
inputs.description: Visible directory name in the current list context that should receive the copied entry.

notes: Validated on 2026-05-12 with temporary probe directories in personal root.
The live page also queried QueryDirectorys and QueryFamilyGroups around the copy dialog, but CopyFile plus the root list refresh are the core write-path signals.

flows.title: Unicom Move Entry
flows.purpose: Move a visible file or directory into another visible directory by driving the file-list selection state and action-dialog submit path.

inputs.label: Entry Name
inputs.description: Visible file or directory name in the current list context.

inputs.label: Target Directory Name
inputs.description: Visible directory name in the current list context that should receive the moved entry.

notes: Validated on 2026-05-12 with temporary probe directories in personal root.
The live page issues a QueryDirectorys preflight before MoveFile, so the operation intentionally waits for the dialog state to settle before submit.
